details:
- Update to shenandoah-jdk8u462-b08 (GA)
- Security fixes from OpenJDK 8u462-b08:
 - CVE-2025-30749: fix 2D vulnerability allowing remote attackers to compromise
   JVM via network access
 - CVE-2025-30754: fix JSSE vulnerability allowing unauthorized data access via
   TLS connections
 - CVE-2025-30761: fix Scripting vulnerability allowing unauthorized data
   modification via network access
 - CVE-2025-50106: fix 2D vulnerability allowing remote attackers to compromise
   JVM via API exploitation
